spans.s:
m. (-कः)
A mountain.
E.
वि various, अंश part, कन् added.

m. (-कः)
A cheat, a rogue, a juggler.
E.
वि before अंस to divide, ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Undressed, naked.
E.
वि priv., and अंशुक a garment.

n. (-नं)
Cheating, tricking, deceiving.
E.
वि before अंस to divide, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be deceived or cheated.
E.
वि before अंस to divide, अनीयर् aff.; also व्यंसितव्य and व्यंस्य.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Deceived, tricked, cheated.
E.
वि before अंस to divide, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Wise, learned.
2 Evident, manifest, apparent, absolutely and specifically known or understood.
3 Individual, specific.
E.
वि before अञ्ज to make clear, aff. क्त.

n. (-त्वं)
Distinctness, manifestation.
E.
त्व added to the last; also व्यक्तता.

m. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
Perceiving, understanding, present.
E.
व्यक्त evident, दृष्ट seen, अर्थ meaning or object, (by whom.)

f. (-शिः)
Known or absolute quantity, (in arithmetic^1)
E.
व्यक्त, and राशि quantity.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-क्ष्मा-क्ष्मा-क्ष्म)
Evident by certain signs or marks, manifested, characterised.
E.
व्यक्त, and लक्ष्मन् a mark.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 Individuality, specific appearance or being.
2 Appearance, manifestation.
3 Case, inflexion, or the proper form of any inflected word.
E.
वि before अघ to make clear, aff. क्तिच्.

f. (-ता)
Individuality.
E.
तल् added to व्यक्ति; also with त्व, व्यक्तित्वं.

n. (-णं)
Making distinct or manifest.
E.
व्यक्ति, and करण making, च्चि aug.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Made clear or manifest.
E.
व्यक्ति, and कृत made, च्चि aug.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Distinct, clear.
E.
व्यक्त, and भूत become, च्चि aug.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Manifested, displayed.
2 Spoken plainly.
E.
व्यक्त, and उदित risen or said.

mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं)
1 Bewildered, perplexed, distracted.
2 Alarmed, agitated, frightened.
3 Engaged in, zealous, eager.
E.
वि before अग्र chief, principal.

f. (-ता)
1 Perplexity, anxiety.
2 Zeal.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, व्यग्रत्वं.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
1 Deformed, lame.
2

Bodiless.
3

Ill-arranged.
m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A frog.
2 A cripple.
3 Discoloration of the face, dark spots on the cheek.
E.
वि depreciative, &c., अङ्ग body.

mfn. (-र;-रा-रं)
Having no fire alight.
E.
वि priv., अङ्गार hot coals.

n. (-लं)
The 60th part of a digit or Aṅgula.
E.
वि, and अङ्गुल a digit.

m. (-ङ्ग्यः)
1 Figurative or poetical speech, elliptical language or that which conveys something more than the simple meaning of the words.
2 Sarcasm, the covert but intelligible expression of suspicion or contempt.
E.
वि before अञ्च to make clear or manifest, घञ् aff., and यत् added.

r. 6th cl. (व्यचति)
To cheat, to trick, to defraud or deceive.

m. (-जः)
A fan.
E.
वि before अज to go, घ aff.

m. (-जः)
1 Deceit, fraud, craft, cunning.
2 Disguise, either of purpose or person.
3 Wickedness.
E.
वि before अज to go, aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
A fan.
E.
वि before अज to go, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-कः)
1 External indication of passion or feeling.
2 A sign, a mark, a symbol.
3 Figurative or elliptical expression.
E.
वि before अञ्ज to manifest, aff. ण्वुल्.

n. (-त्वं)
The nature or existence of figurative or poetical expression.
E.
व्यञ्जक, and त्व added.

n. (-नं)
1 A mark, a spot, a sign, a token.
2 Paraphernalia, insignia.
3 The beard.
4 A privy part, either male or female.
5 Sauce, condiment.
6 A consonant.
nf. (-नं-ना)
1 Figurative expression.
2 Irony, sarcasm.
E.
वि before अञ्ज to make clear or evident, ल्युट् aff.

व्यञ्जनावृत्ति,
f. (-त्तिः)
Rhetorical or elliptical style.
E.
व्यञ्जना, and वृत्ति style.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Making visible or manifest.
E.
वि, and अञ्ज to go, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Distinguished, characterised.
2 Manifested, visible.
E.
वि before अञ्ज to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing or trying to expose, detect. make manifest, &c.
E.
वि before अञ्ज to go, desid. v., उ aff.

m. (-कः)
The castor oil plant, (Ricinus communis.)
E.
वि before अड to strive, aff. अच्, व्यड here said to mean excretion, अवि to go, to cause, ण्वुल् aff.; form irr.; also with युच् aff. व्यडम्बन m. (-नः) and by another reading, व्यडम्बर; other etymologies are given.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Reciprocal, acting on or with one another.
2 Pervading, who or what spreads through or over.
3 Contiguous to, in contact with.
m. (-रः)
1 Misfortune, calamity.
2 Reciprocity, reciprocal action or relation.
3

Reverse.
4

Contact, contiguity.
E.
वि and अति before कृ to make, to do, aff. अप्.

m. (-मः)
1 Inverted or retrograde order, inversion, reverse.
2 Contrariety, opposition in general; as the contrary of what is right or wrong, crime, vice; the contrary of prosperity, adversity, misfortune, &c.
3 Retraction, non-performance, (as of contracts.)
4 Passing over or beyond.
E.
वि and अति before क्रम to go, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Reversed, inverted.
2

Retracted.
3

Passed over.
E.
वि and अति before क्रम to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Different, distinct.
2

Excepted.
3

Withdrawn, withheld.
E.
वि and अति before रिच to unite, aff. क्त.

m. (-कः)
1 Difference, separateness.
2 A figure in rhetoric, the dissimilitude of things compared in some respects to each other.
3 Exception, exclusion.
E.
वि and अति before रिच to unite, aff. घञ्.

f. (-प्तिः)
Comprehensive argument derived from negatives or non-existence.
E.
व्यतिरेक, and व्याप्ति pervading.

mfn. (-की-किणी-कि)
1 Different, reverse.
2 Excepting. distinguishing.
E.
व्यतिरेक, and इनि aff.

n. (-णं)
Illustration by contrast or negatives.
E.
व्यतिरेकिन्, and उदाहरण example.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Mutually connected, joined, related, &c.
E.
वि and अति before षञ्ज to embrace, aff. क्त.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 Mutual or reciprocal junction or relation.
2 Fastening, tying together.
E.
वि and अति before षञ्ज to embrace, and ड aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Connected, united, mixed.
E.
व्यतिषङ्ग, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Barter, exchange.
2 Exchange of blows or abuse.
E.
वि and अति before हृ to take, aff. घञ्; also व्यतीहार.

m. (-रः)
1 Barter, exchange.
2 Exchange of blows or abuse.
E.
वि, and अति implying reciprocity, हृ to take, aff. घञ्, and इ optionally long.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Past, gone.
E.
वि before अतीत the same.

m. (-तः)
1 Great and portentous calamity, or a portent, indicating or occasioning it and therefore identified with it, as a comet, an earthquake, &c.
2 Disrespect, contempt.
3 The seventeenth of the astrological

Yogas.
4

Day of new moon when it falls on a Sunday, and the moon is in certain mansions, Śravaṇā, &c.
E.
वि and अति before पत to fall, &c., aff. घञ.

m. (-यः)
1 Contrariety, opposition, reverse.
2 Inverted or retrograde order.
E.
वि, and अति before इ to go, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Reversed, inverted, contrary, opposite.
E.
वि, and अति before अस to throw, क्त aff.

m. (-सः)
1 Contrariety, opposition, reverse.
2 Inverted or retrograde order.
3 Reversed position.
E.
वि, and अति before अस to throw or send, aff. ष.

r. 1st cl. (व्यथते)
1 To fear.
2 To be disquieted or unhappy.
3 To suffer pain.

Pain.
2

Distress.
3

Alarm, fear.
E.
व्यथ to fear, to suffer pain, &c., aff. अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Inflicting pain, torturing, painful.
2 Distressing, afflicting.
E.
व्यथ to give pain, क्वुन् aff.

n. (-नं)
Giving pain, paining.
E.
व्यथ to pain, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be put to pain, what may be or ought to be pained.
E.
व्यथ, and अनीयर् aff.; also व्यथ्य and व्यथितव्य.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Paining, distressing.
E.
व्यथ to pain, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Painful, excruciating.
E.
व्यथा, and कर what makes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Free from pain.
E.
व्यथा, and रहित quitted.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Pained, tortured.
2 Distressed, afflicted.
3 Disturbed, troubled.
4 Alarmed, frightened.
E.
व्यथा pain, इतच् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being agitated, distressed, pained, &c.
E.
व्यथ to suffer pain, pass. v., शानच् aff.

r. 4th cl. (औ) औव्यध (विध्यति)
To beat, to strike, to pierce, to tear, to hurt or wound.

m. (-धः)
1 A hunter, one who lives by killing deer, &c.
2 A low or wicked man.
E.
व्यध to pierce, ण aff.

m. (-घः)
1 Perforating, piercing.
2 Striking, smiting.
E.
व्यघ to strike, to hurt, aff. अप्.

n. (-नं)
Piercing, perforating.
E.
व्यघ to pierce, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Made, done, caused.

mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
To be pierced or wounded.
m. (-ध्यः)
A butt, a mark to shoot at.
E.
व्यध to pierce, aff. यत्.

m. (-ध्वः)
A bad road.
E.
वि depreciative, अध्वन् a road, अच् aff.

m. (-दः)
Reverberation, loud and extending sound or noise.
E.
वि, and अनु before नद to sound, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
1 Causing to reverberate, filling with sound or noise.
E.
वि, and अनु before नद to sound, causal v., शतृ aff.

r. 10th cl. (व्यापयति)
To diminish, to lessen, to decay.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Gone, gone away.
E.
वि, and अप before गम to go, क्त aff.

m. (-मः)
Going away, departure.
E.
वि, and अप before गम to go, अच् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Ashamed.
E.
वि, and अपत्रप to be shameless, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1

Named.
2

Informed.
3

Tricked.
4

Pleaded in excuse.
E.
वि and अप before दिश to show, क्त aff.

m. (-शः)
1 Dishonesty, fraud, craft.
2 Stratagem, device.
3 Name, appellation.
4 Information, notice, apprising.
5

Hint.
6

Excuse, pretext.
E.
वि and अप before दिश to show, aff. धञ्.

mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्ट्ट)
1 Deceiving, a cheat.
2 One who shows, names, &c.
E.
वि and अप before दिश to show, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Taken away, removed.
E.
वि and अप before नीत taken.

n. (-णं)
Extirpating, expelling.
E.
वि and अप before रुह to grow, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Extirpated, eradicated, expelled.
E.
वि and अप before रुह to grow, causal v., क्त aff.

f. (-तिः)
Repelling, denial.
E.
वि, and अप implying opposition, and आङ् before कृ to make, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-यः)
1 Taking refuge with, relying upon, trusting to.
2 Expectation.
E.
वि, अप and आङ् before श्री to serve, aff. अच्

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Having taken refuge with, relying upon, trusting to, who or what does so.
E.
वि, अप and आङ् before श्री to serve, aff. क्त.

ind.
Having sought or taken refuge with.
E.
वि, अप, and आङ् before श्री to serve, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Expectant, waiting, attentive.
E.
वि and अप before ईक्ष to see, अच् aff.

f. (-क्षा)
1 Expectation, especially if reciprocal.
2 Mutual connexion or relation.
3 Application, use.
4 (In grammar,) the mutual application of two rules.
E.
वि severally, अपेक्षा looking to.

n. (-णं)
Expecting, looking for.
E.
वि and अप before ईक्ष to see, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be expected or looked for.
E.
वि and अप before ईक्ष to see, अनीयर् aff.; also व्यपेक्ष्य and व्यपक्षितव्य.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Looked to reciprocally.
2 Mutually related.
3 Employed, applied.
E.
वि, and अपेक्षित expected.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Gone, passed away, got rid of.
2 Opposed, contrary.
E.
वि and अप before इ to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Opposite, contrary, reverse.
2 Driven off or away.
E.
वि and अप before वह to bear, क्त aff.

ind.
1 Having driven away, got rid of.
2 Having passed through a place.
E.
वि, and अप before वह to convey, ण्यत् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Following improper courses, doing what is prohibited or wicked.
2 Erring, straying, (literally or figuratively.)
3 Wandering from an argument.
E.
वि and अभि before चर to go, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-भ्रः-भ्रा-भ्रं)
Unclouded.
E.
वि priv., अभ्र a cloud.

r. 1st cl. (व्ययति)
To go, to move.
r. 10th cl. (व्यययति)
1 To lessen, to diminish.
2 To send.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (व्ययते व्यययति)
To expend, to disburse, to abandon wealth, to give away money, &c.

m. (-यः)
1 Expenditure, spending.
2 Destruction, disappearance.
3 Misfortune, downfall^1, decline.
E.
व्यय to expend, &c., aff. अच्.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

Spending.
2

Destroying.
E.
व्यय, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Spending, expending.
E.
व्यय to spend, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Expended, spent.
2 Gone, dissipated, dispersed.
3 Declined, fallen into decay.
E.
व्यय to expend, aff. क्त.

Spending.
2

Declining, falling into calamity.
3 Wasting, decaying.
E.
व्यय, and इनि aff.

n. (-णं)
Expending, wasting.
E.
व्यय, and करण making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Expended, spent, wasted.
E.
व्यय, and कृत made, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Spent, wasted.
E.
व्यय, and भत been, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1

Asked.
2

Gone.
E.
अर्द्द to ask, with वि prefix, and क्त aff.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
1 Useless, vain, unprofitable.
2 Unmeaning.
E.
वि privative, and अर्थ meaning, object.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Vain, useless.
E.
कन् added to the last.

f. (-ता)
Unprofitableness, uselessness.
E.
व्यर्थक, and तल् aff.

f. (-ता)
1 Unprofitableness, uselessness.
2 Absence of meaning, nonsense.
E.
तल् added to अर्थ; also with त्व, व्यर्थत्वं.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Disagreeable, displeasing, offensive.
2 Improper, unfit to be done.
3

Painful.
4

Strange.
n. (-कं)
1 Pain, torture.
2 Fault, transgression.
3 Any thing displeasing.
4 Any improper act.
5

Reverse.
6

Cheating, tricking.
m. (-कः)
A catamite.
E.
वि, and अल to be able or to adorn, aff. ईकन्.

Impropriety.
2

Disagreeableness.
E.
तल् added to the last; also व्यलीकत्वं.

n. (-नं)
Subtraction.
E.
वि, and अव before कल to reckon, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
Subtraction, (in arithmetic.)
E.
वि with आङ् and अव before कल to count, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Subtracted, deducted.
n. (-तं)
Subtraction.
E.
वि and अव before कल to count, and क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Subtracted.
E.
वि with आङ् and अव before कल to count, aff. क्त.

n. (-नं)
1 Wrangling, altercation, mutual abuse.
2 Abuse, reviling.
E.
वि and अव before क्रुश to call, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Different, separate, divided.
2 Distinguished, discriminated.
3 Cut in pieces.
E.
वि and अव before छिद to cut, aff. क्त.

m. (-दः)
Dividing, separating.
2 A division.
3 Discrimination.
4 Contrast, distinction.
5 Letting fly an arrow, shooting, darting.
6 Cutting in pieces.
E.
वि and अव before छिद to cut, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Arranged, placed.
E.
वि and अव before स्थ to stay, शानच् aff.

f. (-धा)
1 A covering, a screen, any thing which holds or conceals from sight.
2 The state of being covered, concealment, disappearance.
E.
वि and अव before धा to have, अङ् and टाप् affs.

m. (-नं)
1 Covering, disappearance, either the thing which conceals, or the state of being concealed from sight.
2 Intervening, intervention, space.
3 The intervention of a letter, (in grammar.)
E.
वि and अव before धा to have, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Concealing, screening, hiding.
2 Intervening, intermediate, separating.
E.
वि and अव before धा to have, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-धिः)
Covering, or a covering: see व्यवघान.
E.
वि and अव before धा to have, aff. कि.

m. (-यः)
1 Effort, exertion, persevering or industrious effort, perseverance, industry.
2 Following any business or profession.
3 Plan, device, trick.
4 Resolve, determination.
5 Boasting.
E.
वि and अव before षो to destroy, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Laborious, relating to exertion.
E.
व्यवसाय, and आत्मन् self, with कन् added.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
1 Active, energetic, persevering, resolute.
2 Engaged in business.
E.
व्यवसाय, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Tricked, cheated.
2 Energetic, taking pains, making effort or exertion.
3 Resolved, determined.
n. (-तं)
Certainty, ascertainment.
E.
वि and अव before षो to destroy, aff. क्त.

f. (-स्था)
1 Separating, placing remote or apart.
2 Placing or staying in or on.
3 A decree, a written declaration of the law; applied in practice to the written extracts from the codes of law, stated as the opinions of the Hindu law officers attached to the courts of justice.
4 An engagement, an agreement, a contract.
E.
